name: xai-voice
description: Master reference for xAI's three voice APIs — Grok Text-to-Speech (POST /v1/tts), Speech-to-Text (/v1/stt), and the realtime Speech-to-Speech voice agent (wss://api.x.ai/v1/realtime). Live-verified request/response contracts, the full 26-voice catalog, speech-tag semantics, a production Go client, and the doc-vs-reality discrepancies that bite.
